title: 10-Year Treasury Yield
summary: The 10-Year Treasury yield stood at 4.32% as of April 16, 2026, up 3 basis points from the prior day's close of 4.29%. The yield has oscillated in a narrow range between 4.26% and 4.32% over the past five trading days.
